text_block_list.text:
One day, I'm out with Эль Кондор Паса,
when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Qué bonito! Do my eyes deceive me or
are those
Umamusume plushies?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We could line them up with all my
trophies! Think
how awesome it'd be to
sit down with a plate of
nachos and
check 'em all out!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Claw machines are so fun! They're a hella
exciting
challenge!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But the claw never does what I tell it
to... The last
time I tried, my wallet kept
getting lighter, like
my money was flying
away...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Then when I told Grass about it, all she
did was
lecture me about being more
responsible. I'd
rather not have a repeat
of that...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса trembles a little as the
memory of
Grass's reprimands resurfaces.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, you win one for me instead!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll avenge your poor wallet!

text_block_list.text:
Ooohhh, that's my trainer! I'll be waiting
for my
plushie!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
